name: Polon memories underwater reverie
source:
A young girl came from a small island. Allegedly.
Her name was Polon. She loved to swim, or to be precise, stay under water.

Something mystical, almost mythical, about her love of the water...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ303823.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有個年輕女孩來自一座小島。據說如此。
她叫波隆。她喜歡游泳，準確地說，是喜歡待在水底。

她對水的那份愛，有種神秘、近乎神話般的意味……
